notes.title: Dev Update | What's Changed in a Month? A Lot.
notes.notes:
Hey Pioneers — it's been a while! We're back with a big update on XenoHaven, our alien-world sandbox survival game.

Since our first playtest, we've been carefully listening to your feedback and reworking key parts of the game's systems and direction. And now, we're thrilled to announce that...

🎉 Playtest #2 begins on July 24th!

📍 Steam Page:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461270/_/"][/dynamiclink]

📌 How to join the playtest?

On July 24, head to our Steam page and request access to the playtest. Once approved, you'll be able to download and jump straight into the updated build.

🛠️ If you participated in the first playtest, you don't need to reapply — just update or reinstall XenoHaven Playtest from your library on the 24th to access the latest version.

 

Want to see what's new?

🎬 Check out the visual updates and progress in our latest  dev video .

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/fde44f8c1d973e7cf65287f6011eee7768c0631c.png"]

Thanks again for your continued support — we can't wait to hear what you think of the new changes!


Follow our community to get the latest information!
